spans.s:
द्रोण (णः-णं) 1.
m. n. A measure;
commonly 34
sers or 641b.
m.
The military teacher of the
Pāndus; a raven; a scorpion;
a large piece of water; large
cloud; a tree with white flowers.
f. (णिः-णी) Oval vessel made of
wood or stone, a trough; a coun-
try; a mountain; indigo plant.

द्रोण-काक (कः) 1.
m. A raven.

द्रोण-काकल (लः) 1.
m. Idem.

द्रोण-क्षीरा (रा) 1.
f. A cow that
yields a
Drona of milk.

द्रोण-गन्धिका (का) 1.
f. A plant.

द्रोण-घा (घा) 1.
f. A cow that yields
a
Drona of milk.

द्रोण-दुग्धा (ग्धा) 1.
f. Idem.

द्रो-ण-दुघा (घा) 1.
f. Idem.

द्रोण-पुष्पी (ष्पी) 3.
f. A plant so called.

द्रोण-माना (ना) 1.
f. A cow that
yields a
Drona of milk.

द्रोण-मुख (खः) 1.
m. The capital of
a district, chief of 400 villages.

द्रोण-म्पच (चः-क्षा-चं)
a. Liberal in en-
tertaining, who gives a
Drona.

द्रोणा_चार्य्य (र्य्यः) 1.
m. Drona the
teacher of the
Pāndu princes.

द्रोणिका (का) 1.
f. The indigo
plant.

द्रोणी-दल (लः) 1.
m. A flower (Pan-
danus odoratissimus).

द्रोणी-मुख (खः) 1.
m. The chief of
four hundred villages.

द्रोह (हः) 1.
m. Mischief, rebellion.

द्रोह-चिन्तन (नं) 1.
n. Injurious de-
sign, malice prepense.

द्रोहा_ट (टः) 1.
m. A hunter; a hy-
pocrite; a sort of verse.
